producer_report.summary: Added `later_similar_task` (athena-data introspection.rs): for an accepted defaults proposal, a job landed after the accepting job with no recorded introspection of the same failure class gives Prevented. A recurrence caught at an earlier stage than the pre-acceptance cases (failed < rejected < other) gives DetectedEarlier. Everything else gives NotShown with a reason: same or later stage, recurrence before acceptance, pending/rejected/withdrawn proposal, no later job, no records. `later_similar_task_line` and a new StatusView field `later_similar_task` in status.rs; display.rs prints the line. Filled OLY-10-03 mechanism and measure in docs/spec.toml (measure ends `status: not shown`). Added tests and a CHANGELOG entry. Limitation: landed jobs carry no class in the records, so any later landed job stands for a later task.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/spec.toml OLY-10-03 has mechanism naming the new function path in crates/athena-data/src/records/introspection.rs and the status.rs line function (no longer "none"), owner still Apollo, and a measure ending in `status: not shown` or a label printed by `athena status`; Grep of the entry shows it.
criteria_check.evidence: Edited docs/spec.toml OLY-10-03: mechanism names introspection.rs later_similar_task and status.rs later_similar_task_line; owner Apollo; measure ends `status: not shown`. The policy test passed.

criteria_check.criterion: A new unit test in crates/athena-data/src/records/introspection.rs shows: with an accepted proposal and a later same-class landed job with no recurrence, the check reports prevented; with a later recurrence at an earlier stage it reports detected earlier; with a recurrence at the same or later stage, or with no records, it reports not shown. Run `cargo test -p athena-data introspection`; the test fails if the function body is stubbed to always report not shown.
criteria_check.evidence: The later_similar_task_tests module asserts Prevented, DetectedEarlier and NotShown for each case; `cargo test -p athena-data later_similar_task` passed (5 tests). Two tests assert Prevented/DetectedEarlier, so an always-NotShown stub fails them.

criteria_check.criterion: `athena status` output includes the new later-similar-task line, with the status.rs unit test and a crates/athena-cli test asserting the line equals the StatusView field for both shown and not-shown outcomes. Run `cargo test -p athena-core status` and `cargo test -p athena-cli status`.
criteria_check.evidence: display.rs prints v.later_similar_task. The status.rs test the_later_task_line_names_each_outcome_and_empty_records_are_not_shown passed (70 passed in athena-core status). The CLI test status_prints_the_later_similar_task_line_for_both_outcomes passed in --test status_build_measurement. I did not run the broader `cargo test -p athena-cli status` filter.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test` pass across the workspace.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks (I ran fmt and clippy clean; I did not run the full suite).

criteria_check.criterion: A recurrence of the same class before the proposal was accepted, or a proposal that is only pending or rejected, does not count as the improved process (checked by a negative test in the same test module).
criteria_check.evidence: Test a_recurrence_before_acceptance_or_an_unaccepted_proposal_does_not_count covers a pre-acceptance recurrence and Pending, Rejected and Withdrawn statuses; it passed.

open_issues: Landed jobs carry no failure class, so Prevented treats any later landed job as a later similar task.
The stage ranking (failed < rejected < other) is a judgement; the records define no stage order.
learnings: records.rs re-exports introspection::* by glob, so the new items are exported without an edit there.
Job and record ids sort by time, so JobId ordering compares jobs against the accepting job.
